'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Unknown Player DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Unknown Player]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name blank on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
